subject: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue

Team,

Ahead of the QBR next week I want to lock the headcount queue so we present a clear ask to the execs. I attached the staffing radar and a condensed list of reqs needing approvals or decisions. High-level asks:

- Confirm which reqs we want to push through for Q4 funding (prefer 6 heads max for the slate).
- Identify two backfills that are critical for product continuity (detailed in the spreadsheet).
- Propose any freeze exceptions with justification (customer-impact or legal/regulatory).

Notes from my review: the platform infra eng req (REQ-4521) and a Production ML SWE (REQ-4589) are high impact — both have strong Ok-to-fill cases tied to Q1 targets. Early hiring for the observability PM (REQ-4610) is nice-to-have but could be deferred.

Please reply inline with: Approve / Defer / Freeze and one short reason. I need the consolidated list by EOD Thursday so I can include it in the QBR packet.

Attachments: QBR-staffing-radar.xlsx (sheet: prioritized_reqs), reqs-for-approval.pdf

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
VP, People & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:13:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue

Grace —

Quick take inline:
- REQ-4521 (Platform Infra Eng): Approve — this is gating a set of infra migrations tied to latency targets for Redwood Dedicated. Delay here increases our risk for Q1 commit.
- REQ-4589 (Production ML SWE): Approve — workload growth requires this role; we should add a $15k sign-on to be competitive.
- REQ-4610 (Observability PM): Defer — we can repurpose a contractor to cover backlog for Q4.
- REQ-4633 (Sales Enablement IA): Freeze — low immediate ROI; sales can use contractors.

Also flagging a cross-functional risk: hiring tempo in EU region may require separate headcount — not part of this QBR ask but worth noting for the FY plan.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Engineering
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:02:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue

Thanks Grace — my notes:
- REQ-4521: Approve (agree with Markus). We should add a 6-week hiring window to the req to expedite.
- REQ-4589: Approve, but recommend we interview a senior+ and a mid-level to balance ramp risk.
- REQ-4597 (CS Manager, Enterprise): Approve — upcoming renewal with CloudPartners requires dedicated CS lead; risk to churn if not staffed.
- REQ-4638 (Data Infra Ops): Defer — lower urgency, pipeline ok for Q1.

I can approve REQ-4597 for CS if payroll and contracting are cleared. I'll loop in finance if needed.

Laura Bennett
GM, Customer Success
From: Susan Park <susan@acmetalent.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:20:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue

Hi Grace & Laura —

We reviewed the four role profiles you flagged and confirm availability:
- Production ML SWE (REQ-4589): 3 screened candidates available starting mid-December.
- Platform Infra Eng (REQ-4521): two L5s with infra migration experience; earliest start Jan 4.
- CS Manager (REQ-4597): one qualified candidate ready for final interview.

We can accelerate interviews for REQ-4521 if you approve a + sign-on and a priority requisition tag. I'll hold the candidates for 72 hours on approval.

Best,

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q4 QBR prep — staffing triage & approval queue

Thanks everyone — consolidated decisions below for the QBR packet (final):

Approved (to ask execs for Q4 commit):
- REQ-4521 Platform Infra Eng — Approve, priority requisition, recommend $10–15k sign-on (Markus +1).
- REQ-4589 Production ML SWE — Approve, hire senior+ and mid-level pair (Laura +1).
- REQ-4597 CS Manager (Enterprise) — Approve conditional on finance confirmation (Laura to follow up).

Deferred / Could wait for FY planning:
- REQ-4610 Observability PM — Defer to Q1, cover with contractor.
- REQ-4638 Data Infra Ops — Defer.

Frozen for Q4:
- REQ-4633 Sales Enablement IA — Freeze.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm payroll/finance approval for REQ-4597 by Monday EOD; add to QBR pack if cleared.
- Markus: finalize job spec updates and authorize priority tag for REQ-4521 by Friday.
- Grace: I will include the final slide and ask line in the QBR deck; will request exec approval for up to 6 hires in the Q4 headcount ask.

Grace O'Connor
VP, People & Operations
Redwood Inference
